text: Every planner does what you tell it.
You know what matters. The project. The application. But the week fills up with whatever's loudest.
Press Option D, and tell her what's on your mind, the way you'd actually say it. She books it into the time you really have.
Then she pushes back. Book over a deadline, and she tells you exactly what it costs.
Three Saturdays booked. Three missed. She noticed before you did.
At night, she goes looking for what you should be applying to.
Her thinking runs on your own Mac. Anything that can be worked out is computed, so it's instant, and it can't be made up.
She reads your calendar, and reminds you right on time.
Donna. She doesn't get told what to do. She knows what to do for you.
